title: Sandbox auto WhatsApp on pay
summary: Homepage cart matches live POS billing: optional customer mobile on cart, Print and Pay auto-sends WhatsApp bill when number present, success banner on receipt — no separate WhatsApp button.
highlights: Removed WhatsApp toggle and Send demo invoice section
Customer WhatsApp field on cart like POS customer phone
Print and Pay auto-sends PDF when number is valid; green success on bill settled
